vocabulary.label: monophonic chords
vocabulary.note: monophonic: the chords play their lowest voice alone; the harp stays polyphonic

vocabulary.label: Herbie Hancock's Chameleon
vocabulary.note: Chameleon: the chords are the ARP bass, one voice, an octave down with a quick filter bark; the harp is a clavinet-like pluck. Play the bass line on the chord buttons

vocabulary.label: Van Halen's Jump
vocabulary.note: Jump: big detuned brass chords; play the riff on the chord buttons

vocabulary.label: Toto's Africa
vocabulary.note: Africa: the harp is the kalimba and marimba riff, the chords a soft brass pad

vocabulary.label: Stevie Wonder's Superstition
vocabulary.note: Superstition: clavinet on both; tap the harp hard and soft for the funk

vocabulary.label: a-ha's Take On Me
vocabulary.note: Take On Me: the harp is the bright riff synth; strum or tap it in the scale

vocabulary.label: Vangelis's Blade Runner
vocabulary.note: Blade Runner: slow, swelling brass with vibrato and a huge room; hold the chords

vocabulary.label: classic Omnichord (Gorillaz's Clint Eastwood)
vocabulary.note: Clint Eastwood's rhythm is the minichord's rhythm mode, turned on at the instrument

vocabulary.label: the Who's Baba O'Riley
vocabulary.note: Baba O'Riley: organ chords, and a harp chopped into repeats like the organ's marimba repeat

vocabulary.label: Eurythmics' Sweet Dreams
vocabulary.note: Sweet Dreams: the harp is the bass sequence, an octave down; the chords a dark pad

vocabulary.label: the Stranger Things theme
vocabulary.note: Stranger Things: the harp is the arpeggio; strum it slowly up and down

vocabulary.label: theremin
vocabulary.note: theremin: the chords play one voice that glides; the harp can't glide

vocabulary.label: vocoder
vocabulary.note: the vocoder needs a voice coming in over USB (usb audio set to 0 or 1 in minicontrol)

vocabulary.label: septimal and just alternate chords
vocabulary.note: the alternate chords play in the alternate layout (chord layout 1); they're tuned for 19 and 31-EDO
